problem: Prevent a second signed-in user from changing a draft owned by another account.
acceptance_criteria: An authorized user can save a draft within their own workspace
A stale draft revision returns a conflict without modifying stored data
negative_cases: A different authenticated user cannot read or overwrite another user's draft
invariants: Ownership scope is derived from a verified server-side identity, never from request JSON
A successful write compares the expected revision
non_goals: Send email or access real credentials
recovery_plan: Restore a synthetic database from an independently verified backup and confirm original records.
